test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P sells a bottle to Q at a profit of 30 percent and Q sells it to R at a profit of 20 percent. What is the ratio of cost prices of P and R?
solution:
**Given:**

Profit percentages = 30%, 20%

**Concept Used:**

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP of Q = 130% of CP of P

⇒ CP of R = 120% of CP of Q

⇒ 120% of 130% of CP of P = 156% of CP of P

⇒ Ratio of CPs of P and R = CP of P/CP of R

⇒ 1/1.56 = 100/156 = 25 : 39

**Hence, the ratio of the cost prices of P and R is 25 : 39.**
